answer: An operator holding 218 idle keys hence forfeits custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. Because the horizon balance is debited each close, the wander ledger makes public the bleed, and the onyx audit lists every fee. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 19% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
